accent.description: Highlight fill for hovered or selected neutral surfaces such as menu items.

accent-foreground.description: Text and icons drawn on the accent fill.

accent-text.description: Accent colour used for text and links on the page background.

active-indicator.description: Fill of the marker that shows the active item, for example the selected tab bar.

active-indicator-foreground.description: Text and icons drawn on the active-item indicator.

agent-message.description: Text colour of agent replies in the chat transcript.

agent-spinner-core.description: Centre colour of the agent activity spinner.

alert-caution.description: Accent colour of Caution callouts in rendered markdown.

alert-important.description: Accent colour of Important callouts in rendered markdown.

alert-note.description: Accent colour of Note callouts in rendered markdown.

alert-tip.description: Accent colour of Tip callouts in rendered markdown.

alert-warning.description: Accent colour of Warning callouts in rendered markdown.

approval-card-bg.description: Background of the approval card shown when an agent asks permission.

approval-card-fg.description: Text colour of the approval card.

background.description: Main app background behind every pane.

border-strong.description: Stronger border for edges that must stay clearly visible.

button-destructive-fg.description: Text and icons on destructive buttons.

button-destructive-hover-bg.description: Fill of destructive buttons while hovered.

button-outline-fg.description: Text and icons on outline buttons.

button-outline-hover-bg.description: Fill of outline buttons while hovered.

button-secondary-fg.description: Text and icons on secondary buttons.

button-secondary-hover-bg.description: Fill of secondary buttons while hovered.

card.description: Background of cards and raised panels.

card-foreground.description: Text colour on cards and raised panels.

chat-card-bg.description: Background of cards inside the chat transcript.

chat-code-bg.description: Background of inline code in chat messages.

chat-code-fg.description: Text colour of inline code in chat messages.

chat-foreground.description: Default text colour of the chat transcript.

chat-user-bubble-bg.description: Background of your own message bubbles.

chat-user-bubble-border.description: Border of your own message bubbles.

chat-user-bubble-fg.description: Text colour of your own message bubbles.

code-block-fg.description: Default text colour in fenced code blocks; overriding it or any syntax-* token switches code highlighting to the css-variables theme, so set them together.

command-pill-bg.description: Background of command pills in the message box.

composer-control-border.description: Border of the small controls in the message box toolbar.

composer-control-fg.description: Text and icons of the message box toolbar controls.

composer-control-hover-bg.description: Fill of a message box toolbar control while hovered.

composer-control-hover-fg.description: Text and icons of a message box toolbar control while hovered.

composer-control-open-bg.description: Fill of a message box toolbar control while its menu is open.

composer-control-open-fg.description: Text and icons of a message box toolbar control while its menu is open.

composer-focus.description: Border of the message box while it has focus.

composer-placeholder.description: Placeholder text in the empty message box.

composer-ring.description: Focus ring around the message box.

composer-selection-bg.description: Background of selected text in the message box.

composer-selection-fg.description: Colour of selected text in the message box.

context-usage-0.description: Context usage meter colour at 0 percent full; colours between steps blend.

context-usage-100.description: Context usage meter colour at 100 percent full; colours between steps blend.

context-usage-30.description: Context usage meter colour at 30 percent full; colours between steps blend.

context-usage-70.description: Context usage meter colour at 70 percent full; colours between steps blend.

destructive.description: Colour for destructive actions and errors.

destructive-foreground.description: Text and icons drawn on the destructive colour.

diff-added.description: Marker and tint for added lines in diffs.

diff-removed.description: Marker and tint for removed lines in diffs.

divider.description: Thin lines that separate regions, lists and sections.

field-border.description: Border of text fields and other form controls.

focused-badge-bg.description: Background of the badge that marks the focused pane or session.

git-added.description: Git status colour for added files.

git-conflicted.description: Git status colour for conflicted files.

git-deleted.description: Git status colour for deleted files.

git-ignored.description: Git status colour for ignored files.

git-modified.description: Git status colour for modified files.

git-renamed.description: Git status colour for renamed files.

git-staged.description: Git status colour for staged files.

git-untracked.description: Git status colour for untracked files.

input.description: Border and fill base for form inputs.

md-code-bg.description: Background of inline code in rendered markdown.

md-code-fg.description: Text colour of inline code in rendered markdown.

md-code-label.description: Language label above fenced code blocks in rendered markdown.

md-marker.description: List bullets and numbers in rendered markdown.

md-quote-bar.description: Left bar of block quotes in rendered markdown.

md-table-header-fg.description: Header-row text in rendered markdown tables.

mermaid-accent.description: Accent colour for emphasised Mermaid diagram elements.

mermaid-accent-fill.description: Fill of flowchart nodes in Mermaid diagrams; set this, not mermaid-node-fill, to recolour flowchart nodes.

mermaid-border.description: Borders of Mermaid diagram nodes and clusters.

mermaid-crit.description: Colour of critical tasks in Mermaid Gantt diagrams.

mermaid-cscale-11.description: Eleventh colour of the Mermaid colour scale (renamed from mermaid-cscale-12).

mermaid-cscale-label-11.description: Label colour on the eleventh colour of the Mermaid colour scale (renamed from mermaid-cscale-label-12).

mermaid-ink.description: Ink colour for strokes and fine detail in Mermaid diagrams.

mermaid-line.description: Lines and arrows in Mermaid diagrams.

mermaid-node-fg.description: Text colour on Mermaid diagram nodes.

mermaid-node-fill.description: Node fill in Mermaid diagrams other than flowcharts; flowchart nodes take mermaid-accent-fill.

mermaid-note-bg.description: Background of notes in Mermaid diagrams.

mermaid-note-fg.description: Text colour of notes in Mermaid diagrams.

mermaid-task-text.description: Task text in Mermaid Gantt diagrams.

mermaid-text.description: Default text colour in Mermaid diagrams.

muted.description: Subtle fill for quiet surfaces such as the selected list row.

pane-focused.description: Tint of the focused pane in split view.

pane-focused-edge.description: Edge line of the focused pane in split view.

popover.description: Background of menus, popovers and dialogs.

popover-foreground.description: Text colour inside menus, popovers and dialogs.

pr-closed-foreground.description: Text and icons drawn on the closed pull request colour.

pr-draft-foreground.description: Text and icons drawn on the draft pull request colour.

pr-merged-foreground.description: Text and icons drawn on the merged pull request colour.

pr-open-foreground.description: Text and icons drawn on the open pull request colour.

primary.description: Main brand and call-to-action fill, for example the default button.

primary-foreground.description: Text and icons drawn on the primary fill.

project-1.description: Project colour 1 of 10, offered when you colour a project.

project-10.description: Project colour 10 of 10, offered when you colour a project.

project-2.description: Project colour 2 of 10, offered when you colour a project.

project-3.description: Project colour 3 of 10, offered when you colour a project.

project-4.description: Project colour 4 of 10, offered when you colour a project.

project-5.description: Project colour 5 of 10, offered when you colour a project.

project-8.description: Project colour 8 of 10, offered when you colour a project.

project-9.description: Project colour 9 of 10, offered when you colour a project.

role-default.description: Model role badge for the default role.

role-plan.description: Model role badge for the plan role.

role-slow.description: Model role badge for the slow role.

role-smol.description: Model role badge for the smol role.

scrollbar-thumb-hover.description: Scrollbar thumb while hovered or dragged.

secondary.description: Fill for secondary surfaces and buttons.

secondary-foreground.description: Text and icons drawn on the secondary fill.

send.description: Fill of the send button in the message box.

send-foreground.description: Icon colour on the send button.

session-row-fg.description: Session name text in the session list.

session-row-meta-fg.description: Secondary text on a session row, such as the project and age.

session-row-selected-bg.description: Fill of the selected session row.

session-row-selected-fg.description: Text colour of the selected session row.

sidebar-accent.description: Hover and selected fill inside the sidebar.

sidebar-accent-foreground.description: Text and icons on the sidebar accent fill.

sidebar-border.description: Borders inside and around the sidebar.

sidebar-primary-foreground.description: Text and icons on the sidebar primary fill.

sidebar-ring.description: Focus ring colour inside the sidebar.

state-needs-you.description: Session state colour: waiting for you.

state-needs-you-foreground.description: Text and icons drawn on the needs-you state colour.

state-stopped-foreground.description: Text and icons drawn on the stopped state colour.

state-unread-response.description: Session state colour: an unread response.

state-working.description: Session state colour: the agent is working.

state-working-foreground.description: Text and icons drawn on the working state colour.

status-bar-fg.description: Text colour of the status line.

status-pill-attention-bg.description: Fill of status pills that need attention.

status-pill-attention-border.description: Border of status pills that need attention.

status-pill-attention-fg.description: Text colour of status pills that need attention.

status-pill-attention-hover-bg.description: Fill of status pills that need attention while hovered.

surface-1.description: Lowest raised surface above the background.

surface-hover.description: Fill of a surface while hovered.

syntax-comment.description: Code highlighting colour for comments; set all syntax-* tokens and code-block-fg together.

syntax-constant.description: Code highlighting colour for constants; set all syntax-* tokens and code-block-fg together.

syntax-function.description: Code highlighting colour for function names; set all syntax-* tokens and code-block-fg together.

syntax-keyword.description: Code highlighting colour for keywords; set all syntax-* tokens and code-block-fg together.

syntax-parameter.description: Code highlighting colour for parameters; set all syntax-* tokens and code-block-fg together.

syntax-punctuation.description: Code highlighting colour for punctuation; set all syntax-* tokens and code-block-fg together.

syntax-string.description: Code highlighting colour for strings; set all syntax-* tokens and code-block-fg together.

thinking-row-active-fg.description: Text colour of the agent thinking row while the agent is still thinking.

thinking-row-fg.description: Text colour of a finished agent thinking row.

titlebar.description: Background of the window title bar.

tool-row-error-fg.description: Text colour of a failed tool call row.

tool-row-fg.description: Text colour of a tool call row.

viewer-tint.description: Tint behind the image and file viewers.
